mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of rising retail sales and housing starts, the demand for consumer goods and services increases, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: rising retail sales and housing starts
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST are both rising, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past three months indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and economic activity, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO has increased for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% in a single month, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and a decline in the unemployment rate signals strong consumer demand and labor market confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of rising inflation as measured by CPI, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
